# Best home backup power stations under $1,000

For most homes, I'd pick the **Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2** (about $900). If you only need to cover a night or a short outage, the **BLUETTI AC180** (about $499) is the better value.

## Top pick: Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2, about $899.99
- It has 2,048 Wh, 2,400 W output, and a 10 ms UPS switchover.
- It can add a BP2000 battery pack later to reach 4 kWh. The Elite 200 V2 can't expand.
- Outage Authority estimates about 23 hours for a fridge, CPAP, and router combined. Outage Outfitter's figure of 1.6 days for a fridge alone is consistent with that.
- Where to buy: Outage Authority's Amazon and Anker links are on [their home backup roundup](https://outageauthority.com/roundups/best-power-station-home-backup), and Outage Outfitter's Amazon link is on [their under-$1,000 list](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/).

## Best value: BLUETTI AC180, $499
- It has 1,152 Wh and 1,800 W output, and its LiFePO4 battery is rated for 3,500+ cycles with a 5-year warranty.
- It holds about 22 hours of fridge-only runtime, or roughly 13 hours with a fridge, CPAP, and router.
- Code AFF5OFF took $24.95 off in a cart test on 2026-10-21, bringing it to about $474.05. [Buy at BLUETTI's official store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180). This is an affiliate link, and the store's checkout price is what counts.
- It has no expansion port, and at 35.3 lb it's a two-hand carry.

## Other good options
- **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 (2,074 Wh, 2,600 W):** Its battery is rated for 6,000 cycles. Compare Power Stations and Outage Outfitter list it at $899, but Outage Authority says it returned to $1,199 on Oct 7 (Amazon had it at $798.99 that day). Check the live price before buying, because it's only worth it near $900 or less. See [Outage Outfitter's listing](https://outageoutfitter.com/best/under-1000/).
- **Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 (1,070 Wh, 1,500 W):** It's the lightest at 23.8 lb. It costs $489 at Outbound Power but $559 on Jackery's own site. Its 400 W solar input is low. See [the review](https://outageauthority.com/reviews/jackery-explorer-1000-v2).
- **Anker SOLIX F1500 (1,536 Wh):** Compare Power Stations lists it at $599.99 and ranks it first on spec value. That's a single source, and I couldn't confirm the price elsewhere. See [their ranking](https://comparepowerstations.com/best/best-under-1000/).
- **BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 (1,024 Wh, 1,800 W):** It's $499 at Home Depot but currently shows out of stock. See [the listing](https://www.homedepot.com/p/337557774).

## Caveats
- Outage Outfitter says it hasn't tested these units itself, and the runtime figures are estimates based on manufacturer specs.
- Prices change often, so confirm at checkout.
- Running a well pump or central AC takes a much larger system than any of these.

Tell me what you need to keep running (fridge, CPAP, window AC, and so on) and how long, and I can narrow it to one pick.
